description: Source code for the mod_accesslog module of lighttpd 2, implementing server access logging with customizable log formats.

classes.name: al_data
classes.description: Structure holding module-specific data, including timestamp index.

classes.name: al_format
classes.description: Represents a log format specifier, including character, whether it needs a key, and its type.

classes.name: al_format_entry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the log format, either a format specifier or a static string.

methods.name: al_append_escaped
methods.description: Escapes non-printable characters in a string for safe logging.

methods.name: al_get_format
methods.description: Returns the al_format corresponding to a format character.

methods.name: al_parse_format
methods.description: Parses a format string into an array of format entries.

methods.name: al_format_log
methods.description: Generates a log line based on the request, response, and format array.

methods.name: al_handle_vrclose
methods.description: Logs the request when a virtual request is closed.

methods.name: al_option_accesslog_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for the access log file path.

methods.name: al_option_accesslog_format_free
methods.description: Frees the memory used by the parsed format array.

methods.name: al_option_accesslog_format_parse
methods.description: Parses the 'accesslog.format' option value into a format array.

methods.name: plugin_accesslog_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting up options and timestamp format.
